budget_rule: Use the first run_state deadline once, at most 900 seconds from the first launch-budget timestamp and no later than the absolute deadline; never reset on retry
scope: create_project, required xvhdl/xelab, write/read bounded XSim only, including 1280-bit and 640-bit cases
repair_rule: Same sole task versions ordinary execution repairs and retains evidence; changed frozen inputs require manager acknowledgement before native retry, with original deadline retained
closeout_rule: Record root exit and three empty owned Job observations, publish execution plus self-review; manager checks closure; no automatic next grant
